page.overview:
What is Atrium?

The Atrium is a major location in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach. It serves as the gateway to all the attractions in the Mega Pizzaplex.

{|class="article-table" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="text-align:center;"

{|class="article-table" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="text-align:center;"

The Atrium is a large dark purple room with blue accents. It has 3 floors and serves as the gateway to all the locations of the Pizzaplex. A neon star on top illuminates the whole place, along with other lights.
